title: RBAC v2: audit retention rotation, admin-proofing, and SAML assertion gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Consolidate RBAC v2 policy mapping with hardened admin controls, formalize audit log retention/rotation and SIEM forwarding, and implement SAML assertion gating rules discovered during the recent pen-test and threat model review.

Scope:
- Audit retention: standardize retention windows for admin-level events vs. service-level events; implement immutable append-only storage + automatic rotation for >90d archives.
- Audit forwarding: ensure reliable delivery to enterprise SIEM (backpressure/backfill behavior, failover Kafka sink, verification metrics).
- RBAC v2 policy synthesis: reconcile differences between policy engine and Console UI (role->permission matrix), remove legacy implicit-allow rules, and add explicit deny for critical admin flows.
- Admin-proofing: add session confirmation for destructive admin actions, step-up SSO for high-risk operations, and tighten token scopes for management APIs.
- SAML gating: validate assertion lifetimes, audience restrictions, and secondary binding checks for admin-level SSO; address test findings re: replay and missing InResponseTo checks.
- Pen-test remediation: triage pen-test findings (PRIORITY: assertion replay, audit omission on delegated roles, unlogged RBAC overrides) with concrete code and infra changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- All admin-relevant events (role changes, grant/revoke, token issuance, SAML assertion validation failures) are logged and retained per policy; retention/rotation automated and tested.
- SIEM forwarding has at-least-once delivery with monitored lag metrics and documented runbook for backfills.
- RBAC v2 policy matrix has no implicit allow paths for admin actions; unit and integration tests cover representative escalation scenarios.
- SAML assertions validated against recommended OWASP checks with CI tests simulating replay and invalid audience.
- Pen-test items closed or assigned with clear owners and PRs merged behind feature flags where appropriate.

Notes: This task touches runtime, console, auth-service, and ops. We'll coordinate with PM and infra to schedule a canary rollout and a short read-only audit window prior to full enforcement.
